data.text:
Jagadeeswaran S vs The Food Safety Officer on 23 May, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Crl.MC No.5366/2020 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Thursday, the 23rd day of May 2024 / 2nd Jyaishta, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2020 In Crl.Mc No. 5366 Of 2020
 Cc 369/2019 Of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court -I, Kanjirappally,
 Kottayam
 Applicants/Petitioners:
 1. Jagadeeswaran S., Eastern Condiments Pvt Ltd, 4-1-145/2,
 Mariammankovilpatty, Kodangipatty P.O., Theni, Tamil Nadu, Pin
 625 531
 And 3 Others
 Respondent/Respondent:
 1. The Food Safety Officer, Kanijarapally Circle, Kanjirapally,
 Kottayam 686 507
 And 2 Others
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the High
 Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in Cc No.369 of 2019
 pending on the files of the Court of the Judicial Magistrate of the
 First Class-I, Kanjirappally, pending disposal of the above Criminal
 Miscellaneous Case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders on this day along with
 connected cases, upon perusing the application and this Court's order
 dated 23/11/2023 in Crl.M.A.1/2020 and upon hearing the arguments of
 M/S. P.Vijaya Bhanu (Sr.), M.Revikrishnan, Ajeesh K.Sasi, P.M.Rafiq,
 Thomas J.Anakkallunkal, V.C.Sarath, Vipin Narayan, Pooja Pankaj, Sruthy
 N. Bhat, Abel Tom Benny & Kiran Antony, Advocates for the petitioners
 and the Public Prosecutor for R1 & R2 and of Sri.Santhan V. Nair,
 Advocate for R3, the court passed the following:
Jagadeeswaran S vs The Food Safety Officer on 23 May, 2024
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95806191/
1

 Order
Interim order shall stand extended by two months. 
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 23-05-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Jagadeeswaran S vs The Food Safety Officer on 23 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95806191/
